image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a roll of toilet paper mounted on a metallic holder. The paper is white with a visible embossed texture (dotted/quilted pattern). The cardboard core is partially visible through the center hole and at the edge where the paper meets the holder. A dark, blurry object (likely a trash can lid or part of the fixture) is visible at the bottom. The lighting is warm and slightly dim, casting soft shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions relative to the visible holder hardware appear standard for household toilet paper.
